readerCorrection.rule: Prove the exact NativeSrcBridge producer, a new release within its actual handle, and exact full-report retention at every subsequent point.

traceClockSource.derivation: Default NativeReasoningMemory clock is unmodified Date.now()/1000; authority constructs it without options. Each new reasoning:trace id must be bounded by its actual service.handle wall-clock interval.

activeClockSource.rule: Snapshot activeSeconds is bounded by actual runtime elapsedMs before/after the same service.handle and its unmodified performance.now interval. executionMs is zero. No clock replacement or numerical normalization.

releaseDurationSource.producer: NativeSrcBridge.run in v6-composition-engine.ts; NativeCompositionAuthority uses its default performance.now clock without an override.
releaseDurationSource.persistence: NativeEngine.persist copies the report into a src_decision trace before NativeSrcBridge appends total_ms; the entire semantic report must equal that graph trace body.
releaseDurationSource.exposure: NativeCompositionAuthority.release stores the report in lastRelease; snapshot exposes it as whyAct.decision. A successful runtime release appends why_act_release with the actual role graph chain.
releaseDurationSource.newReport: Only init/resume may create a report in these fixed forms. The new release chain and unique matching src_decision trace must be in this same handle. Duration is finite, nonnegative and bounded by both observed monotonic handle time and active elapsed growth.
releaseDurationSource.retainedReport: On advance/inspect, the release note and complete report including total_ms must equal the original creation values exactly. Current bridgeSequence alone is not a release identifier.
releaseDurationSource.comparison: Only /whyAct/decision/total_ms may differ between roles after both proofs. Every other leaf of whyAct, decision, proposal and both complete snapshots remains compared.

qualification: Fresh functional pair of exact Site 108 published 0.67 and frozen final Chart candidate 0.68. Every role graph, delta, fragment, executable digest and ticket binding is independently validated. Full snapshots, proposals, decisions, common owner states and all raw graph leaves are compared. Only the three declared Chart roots and their content-verified reachable fragments may extend population; BranchRouting is common and retains no exemption. Source identity and explicitly proved coverage additions are attributed narrowly. Exact trace creation clocks are bounded by real Date.now intervals; activeSeconds is bounded by observed real performance.now and source elapsed counters. The exact whyAct.decision.total_ms scalar is attributed only after matching the complete persisted source decision, bounding creation in its own actual handle, and proving exact full-report retention thereafter. No clock is replaced, no field is omitted, no arbitrary timing normalization is allowed, and any unexplained difference fails qualification. Chart registration/negative foreign probes are not positive acquisition or official success. No original oracle, game engine, timing readiness or publication is authorized by this artifact.
